scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Failed to show empathy at [03:20] and [06:40] when customer voiced extreme panic regarding NHS midwife labor triage calls.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Failed to paraphrase customer's indoor signal loss issue in own words.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Asked customer at [08:50] for her handset model which had already been verified at [00:45].

grader.scenario: Mobile handset dropping from 4G to No Service indoors; Wi-Fi Calling setup required
grader.notes: Good technical walk-through of Samsung Wi-Fi Calling setup during a local mast outage, but agent failed empathy regarding on-call NHS midwife labor emergencies, offered no paraphrase, and repeated a question about handset model in the last third of the call.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net mobile customer care' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Grace throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Customer voiced acute anxiety regarding on-call maternity labor emergencies; agent offered no empathy and recited technical protocols.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the indoor mobile signal problem in his own words.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent asked for handset model at turn 42 despite customer stating Samsung Galaxy S23 at turn 3.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent guided customer step-by-step through Samsung settings to enable Wi-Fi Calling.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained a courteous instructional tone throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked relevant questions regarding outage timing and indoor signal behavior.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer confirmed Wi-Fi Calling icon active, set Wi-Fi preferred, and verified test call with husband.
